target_customer: Professionals seeking career advice, and experts willing to answer in audio
problem: Good professional advice is hard to find; Quest offered a Q&A app where experts answer in short audio clips.
business_model: Consumer audio Q&A, monetization not stated

founders.name: Emiel van Liere
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder and CTO in Amsterdam.

exit.reason: Company page says unfortunately we have shut down; no cause given there.

technical_complexity.rationale: Audio recording and Q&A feed are standard mobile engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Content community with no lock in; easy to copy.

market_need_then: The founders cite the difficulty of finding professional advice after shipping their earlier app Cooper, per a Product Hunt post; no metrics found.

branding.domain_note: Hosted under the founder's personal site gaal.co/quest; no own domain found.

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated companies named Quest; no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Quest, an audio career Q&A app from Amsterdam, took YC money in 2021 and later shut down per the founder's page. One aggregator claims it failed to find product market fit, but this is a single unverified source, so the cause is not public.
notes: Shutdown date not found. Aggregator claim of near 2 million dollars raised and a 2022 shutdown is unverified. Product Hunt post is undated in the snippet. The Sifted launch article of 2021-08-29 was referenced on the YC page but could not be found by search. Competitor searches returned only unrelated Quest products, so the list is empty. A site lists the founding year as 2023, conflicting with YC 2018.
